$comment: FATHOM EDITORIAL JUDGEMENT -- NOT a CISA or MITRE publication.
basis: The project specification defines the risk score in terms of 'high-impact techniques' but does not enumerate them. Fathom therefore commits an explicit, versioned list rather than letting the value float. A technique is treated as high-impact when its successful use either (a) yields or manipulates identity, credentials, or privilege in the tenant, or (b) destroys or denies access to tenant data. Every ID below is a real MITRE ATT&CK technique that CISA's SCuBA baselines actually reference, so the list introduces no techniques of Fathom's own invention. Edit this file to retune the score; it is data, never model output.
